Copix Desktop 4.5.0 is the Code-OSS shell (microsoft/vscode 1.141.0, MIT) with the Copix agent.

The macOS disk image volume is **Copix 4.5.0**. This release is a draft.

- Activity bar: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Copix Agent, Settings
- File icons, tabs, breadcrumbs, minimap
- Bottom panel: Terminal, Problems, Output
- Status bar: git branch, current model, Ollama
- Copix Agent docked on the right, with inline diffs and Accept / Reject
- Ollama and OpenRouter. The OpenRouter key stays in the OS keychain
- Open VSX gallery. Telemetry off. No third-party extensions by default
- First-run walkthrough and editor state kept across window blur
